title: MatMix Solo #43 (새 재질 솔로 · 옥 라벤더 · 체형 hourglass bombshell · 인종 Middle Eastern · 메이크업 글래스 스킨 3단계 · 강함 · 배경 숲길(황금빛 오후) · 힐 숫자 없음 · 몸 주얼리)
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, early 30s goddess, hourglass bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum, thighs pressing together, every curve maximized at once, long curly dark brown hair — full body polished carved lavender jade fused directly to her own form covering EVERY inch of skin from neck to ankle WITHOUT EXCEPTION, both legs FULLY covered to ankles, NO bare skin below neck ANYWHERE — this is not a garment, not jewelry, not a printed pattern, this is solid jade curving to follow her body's true three-dimensional shape, divided into dozens of fitted jade sections, each joint standing in a thin raised ridge catching its own bright glint and casting its own small shadow, nothing lying flat. Dense fitted sections — BLAZING soft lavender-violet jade surface across the full torso both legs neck to ankle, VIVID pale mauve and white veins running between the sections, with silver filigree inlay curling across the sections, high-gloss polished, completely opaque, NO airbrush NO gradient wash, NO flat printed surface anywhere. Pose: standing full height, both arms slightly spread commanding the frame — most extreme hourglass bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, pointed platform stiletto pumps made of the same jade, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her whole hand, made of the same jade with a high polish.
Jewelry: a long layered gold necklace falling between her breasts, sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms, and a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face and ears are NOT jade — they are real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.

Background: a bright sun-dappled forest path with a packed earth floor, a waist-high wooden rail, a standard bench and tall straight trees, in warm golden late-afternoon light, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void, completely empty of other people, no readable signs or text anywhere, no props or statues made of the same material as her. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. Pattern density MAXIMUM — zero bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
